TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

  IN COUNCIL CHAMBER AT 3031 TORRANCE BL.

  CITY COUNCIL MAY TAKE ACTION ON ANY ITEM LISTED ON THE AGENDA

Revised City Council Agenda 01-09-24

2.  FLAG SALUTE: Councilmember Lewis

NON SECTARIAN INVOCATION: Councilmember Mattucci

3.  REPORT OF THE CITY CLERK ON THE POSTING OF THE AGENDA The agenda was
  posted on the Public Notice Board at 3031 Torrance Bl. and on the City’s Website on

  3 - Affidavit

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER
NUMBER & TITLE – See Council Rules of Order Section 2.11 (Resolution 2006-65)

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. PROCLAMATION honoring Torrance Centenarian Margaret H. Partsch.
  6A - STAFF REPORT

  6B. Recognition of the North High Saxon Regiment.

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15 minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comment on items that are not on the agenda. Under the
  Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment,
  but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification;
  or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral
  Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per
  speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. Speakers please turn off or
  leave your cellular phone when you come to the microphone to speak. If presenting
  handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before
  speaking.
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  PUBLIC COMMENT RECEIVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 01/08/24 AND BEFORE 9:40 P.M.
  ON 01/09/24

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  None Scheduled.

RECESS

RECONVENE

9.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  9A. Police – Receive Update on Torrance Police Department’s New E-Bike Safety
  Program. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Chief of Police that City Council receive an update on the Torrance
  Police Department’s new E-Bike Safety Program.
   9A - STAFF REPORT
  9A - STAFF PRESENTATION

  9B. Public Works – Adopt RESOLUTION Approving Application for Grant Funds for
  the Environmental Enhancement and Mitigation Program. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council adopt a RESOLUTION
  approving the application for grant funds with the California Natural Resources Agency for
  the Environmental Enhancement and Mitigation Program.
  9B - STAFF REPORT
  9B - SUPPLEMENTAL

  9C. City Attorney – Appoint Deputy City Attorney I. Expenditure: $134,707 Annually
  (General Fund).
  Recommendation of the City Attorney that City Council appoint Galen Bean to the position
  of Deputy City Attorney I.
  9C - STAFF REPORT

  9D. City Attorney – Appoint Deputy City Attorney III. Expenditure: $202,226 Annually
  (General Fund).
  Recommendation of the City Attorney that City Council appoint Jennifer Guerrero to the
  position of Deputy City Attorney III.
  9D - STAFF REPORT

*The following item was added on Friday, January 5, 2024.

  9E.  City Manager - Adopt RESOLUTION Pursuant to Memorandum of Understanding
  (MOU) Setting Forth Hours, Wages, and Working Conditions for Torrance Fire
  Fighters Association (TFFA). Expenditure: $6,098,972 (General Fund:
  Approximately $1,524,743 Annually).
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council adopt a RESOLUTION pursuant to
  the memorandum of understanding (MOU) setting forth the hours, wages, and working
  conditions for employees represented by the Torrance Fire Fighters Association (TFFA) for
  the period beginning December 31, 2023, and ending December 31, 2027.
  9E - STAFF REPORT

10.  HEARINGS

  10A. Community Development – Consider Appeal of Planning Commission Denial of
  Planning Commission Review to Allow Construction of a New Two-Unit
  Residential Development, in Conjunction with Demolition of a Contributing
  Structure, and Conditional Use Permit to Allow Development that Exceeds 0.65
  Floor Area Ratio, on Property Located within the Torrance Tract Overlay in the R-
  2 Zone at 1724 Arlington Avenue. The Project is Categorically Exempt from
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) per Guidelines Section 15303 – New
  Construction. PCR21-00001, CUP21-00010: Shaunt Nazarian. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Planning Commission and Community Development Director that
  City Council:
  1) Deny the appeal; and
  2) Adopt a RESOLUTION denying the appeal and denying without prejudice a Planning
  Commission Review to allow the construction of a new two-unit residential
  development, in conjunction with the demolition of a contributing single-family
  residence on property located within the Torrance Tract Overlay in the R-2 Zone at
  1724 Arlington Avenue; and
  3) Adopt a RESOLUTION denying the appeal and denying without prejudice a Conditional
  Use Permit to allow the construction of a new two-unit residential development that
  exceeds a 0.65 floor area ratio on property located within the Torrance Tract Overlay in
  the R-2 Zone at 1724 Arlington Avenue.
  10A - STAFF REPORT
  10A - APPELLANT PRESENTATION

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.

12.  2ND READING ORDINANCES
   12A. Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3928 amending Torrance
  Municipal Code to add Section 31.1.10 to Article 1 of Chapter 1 of Division 3
  regarding flight schools and approve Ordinance Summary for publication.
  12A - STAFF REPORT

13.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15 minute period) Council Order –
  Mattucci, Sheikh, Griffiths, Kaji, Kalani, Lewis, Mayor Chen This portion of the meeting
  is reserved for comment on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act,
  City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond
  briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item
  to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral
  Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you
  step up to the microphone. Speakers please turn off or leave your cellular phone
  when you come to the microphone to speak. If presenting handout material to
  Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.

15.  ADJOURNMENT

  15A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, January 23, 2024, at 5:00 p.m.
  for closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the
  Council Chamber. Tuesday, January 16, 2024, is a Council Dark Night.
  15A - STAFF REPORT
